results.name: Clip changes cannot borrow another batch clip
Additive and straight alpha cannot share one pipeline
Texture boundaries affect actual sampled color
Compatible adjacent geometry can share a draw batch without reordering
Vertex capacity splits geometry without changing output
Unsupported pipeline and malformed clip are rejected before batching
Seeded independent batch consumer equals full per-command oracle
Global texture sort still has a transparent-order counterexample

limitations: Finite rectangle, single-texel, straight/additive alpha model only.
Independent CPU consumer uses batch header state; no arbitrary mask/filter/stencil or full material system.
No GPU timing, engine performance or production host acceptance.
